title: AI Brand Color Palette Generator
prompt_text: Using Canva, generate five harmonious color palettes for eco-friendly brands. Include HEX, RGB, emotional tone (calm, trust, energy), and best background/text color pairing suggestions.
output_text: Five brand color palettes with HEX, RGB, and mood annotations.

title: Podcast Audio Cleanup Assistant
prompt_text: Use ChatGPT to generate a workflow for cleaning raw podcast audio using Audacity or similar tools. Include noise reduction, EQ settings, compression, and normalization parameters.
output_text: Detailed audio cleanup workflow for podcasters with tool settings.

title: AI Workflow Optimizer
prompt_text: Claude helps create an automation plan using Notion and Zapier to automatically collect client feedback, summarize it weekly, and email insights to the design team.
output_text: Automated workflow diagram and email summary structure.

title: Logo Sketch Ideation with DALL-E
prompt_text: Generate 5 minimalist logo concepts for a startup café called 'Morning Fuel'. Include negative space usage, warm color tones, and icons inspired by sun and coffee.
output_text: Five AI-generated logo sketch concepts ready for refinement.

title: AI Business Pitch Script Generator
prompt_text: DeepSeek creates a 3-minute investor pitch script for a fintech startup helping freelancers manage income tax filings. Include hook, problem, solution, and traction sections.
output_text: Investor-ready pitch script highlighting USP and financial traction.

title: UX Heatmap Analysis Explainer
prompt_text: Flow analyzes website heatmap data and explains user behavior patterns. Include visual interpretation, problem areas, and 3 actionable recommendations for conversion improvement.
output_text: User behavior summary with heatmap insights and UX improvement plan.

title: Visual Resume Designer
prompt_text: FreePik helps generate a creative one-page resume design concept for a graphic designer. Include sections for skills visualization, achievements, and color-coded experience timeline.
output_text: A modern, visually styled resume concept for creative professionals.

title: AI-Powered Fitness Habit Tracker
prompt_text: Gemini builds a daily fitness tracking system that records workouts, water intake, and meditation minutes, then visualizes weekly performance with motivational feedback.
output_text: AI-based dashboard summary of fitness habits and trends.

title: AI Image Story Expansion
prompt_text: OpenArt expands any uploaded portrait photo into a full scene that narrates a backstory visually — using lighting, objects, and surrounding mood elements.
output_text: Expanded scene generation around existing portrait photo.

title: AI SEO Title Optimizer
prompt_text: Perplexity rewrites 10 blog titles to improve CTR based on keyword intent, emotional impact, and SERP analysis. Include reason for each improvement.
output_text: Optimized SEO titles with CTR-focused reasoning.

title: Smart Legal Document Summarizer
prompt_text: Qwen reads a 5-page contract and produces a 1-page summary focusing on obligations, risks, and deadlines with a traffic-light color code system.
output_text: Concise summary of legal clauses with risk indicators.

title: Short Film Scene Generator
prompt_text: RunwayML writes and visualizes a short 30-second film scene set in an old bookstore. Include scene description, dialogue, camera shot types, and lighting suggestions.
output_text: Visual storyboard with dialogues and cinematic mood details.

title: AI Customer Query Classifier
prompt_text: Hailuo categorizes 200+ customer support messages into topics: shipping, refund, product quality. Returns labeled dataset and common sentiment insights.
output_text: Structured classification output with sentiment distribution chart.

title: AI Business Trend Predictor
prompt_text: HiggsField analyzes 5 years of sales data to predict emerging product categories in e-commerce, visualized with confidence levels and trendlines.
output_text: Forecast graph showing probable market trends for 2026.

title: Idea Sketch Generator
prompt_text: IdeoGram creates 3 sketched design ideas for packaging a luxury tea brand. Focus on minimalism, matte textures, and embossed typography concepts.
output_text: 3 conceptual sketches of luxury tea packaging designs.

title: AI Music Remix Assistant
prompt_text: Musicful suggests remix arrangements for a 1-minute song clip, proposing tempo shifts, instrument layering, and transitions matching genre.
output_text: Music remix blueprint with tempo and arrangement guide.

title: AI Video Scene Editor
prompt_text: Kling transforms a static photo into a 5-second animated cinematic shot using parallax depth and subtle camera movement effects.
output_text: Short cinematic motion effect clip derived from a photo.
